Package ca.refundr.highspring.api.scope

Class ServerScope

java.lang.Object
ca.refundr.highspring.api.scope.ServerScope
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class ServerScope extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Long-lived server services shared by every request.

Created once at process start (Server). Holds:

  • config + database pool
  • OAuth provider (real Google, or a stub in tests)
  • CartPricingService
  • ErrorReporter composite (log + DB + email + Sentry stub)

Per-request state belongs in RequestScope, created via createRequest(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse).
